block.rounding: the output stage's single rounding of section 4.4, performed by ot_fp32_rne_pkg::fp32_to_bf16_rne -- the same function the lane's own output stage and ot_a3_vector_add use, not a second implementation of it
block.why_it_exists: results/rtl/abi3_boundary_chain.json established by elaboration that ot_a3_tile64's act_wr_en is an internal net and that nothing in the design wrote a reduction root into a consumer tile's activation FIFO.  This is that block

cases_declared.name: g1_b1_w64
cases_declared.note: the two-tile chain's own geometry: one K-block slice of 64 BF16 activations at g = 1, one element per 64-bit word

cases_declared.name: g1_b2_w64
cases_declared.note: two slices: the FIFO's two regions, alternated

cases_declared.name: g1_b3_w32
cases_declared.note: three slices: slice 2 rewrites slice 0's region

cases_declared.name: g2_b2_w32
cases_declared.note: g = 2: two elements per activation word

cases_declared.name: g4_b2_w16
cases_declared.note: g = 4: four elements per activation word

cases_declared.name: g1_b1_gap3
cases_declared.note: three idle cycles between roots: arrival rate does not change what is delivered

cases_declared.name: g1_b1_saturating
cases_declared.note: roots at the top of binary32: the narrowing saturates and is counted, and is not a fault

cases_declared.name: g1_b1_tiny
cases_declared.note: roots below the BF16 subnormal floor: they flush to zero

cases_declared.name: refuse_dtype
cases_declared.note: an activation format that is not BF16: fp32 -> FP8 is a two-output quantisation this block does not perform

cases_declared.name: refuse_scaled
cases_declared.note: a block-scaled activation: the E8M0 interleave is unwritten

cases_declared.name: refuse_window
cases_declared.note: a slice that does not fit the activation FIFO

cases_declared.name: fault_tag_order
cases_declared.note: a root out of ascending tag order

cases_declared.name: fault_act_range
cases_declared.note: the odd slice's destination outside the FIFO

cases_declared.name: fault_slice_overrun
cases_declared.note: more roots than the operation's slices hold

cases_declared.name: fault_nonfinite
cases_declared.note: a root that is not finite

does_not_establish.any_boundary_latency: the readiness delay is the receiver's own two cycles, not a dependent boundary.  The two-tile chain measurement is a separate campaign
does_not_establish.narrower_activation_formats: fp32 -> FP8 or MXFP4 is a two-output quantisation, which ot_a3_vector_convert also refuses; the receiver refuses it rather than inventing one
does_not_establish.physical_realisability: simulation says nothing about area, timing or power; no routed record of this block exists
does_not_establish.scaled_activations: a block-scaled activation is refused: the E8M0 activation interleave is recorded as unwritten in ot_a3_tile64's own header, and no quantising output stage exists to emit one
does_not_establish.the_link_itself: the root is presented on a port.  What a traversal costs is ot_a3_link_channel's, and results/rtl/a3_link_campaign.json regresses it

establishes: that a binary32 root off the link becomes the consumer tile's activation word: rounded once to BF16 with round-to-nearest-even, packed g elements to a 64-bit word, written on the tile's own activation broadcast port at op_a_base + (b mod 2) x op_a_block_stride + w, and compared word for word
that act_ready_kblocks advances exactly one slice at a time and only after the slice's last word has landed in the array, so the tile's S_WAIT gate cannot open on a word that is not there
that the readiness delay does not depend on g, on the slice count, on the base, or on the rate the roots arrive at
six distinct fail-closed modes, including a root that is not finite and a root out of ascending tag order
that saturation in the narrowing is COUNTED and is not a fault, as it is in the lane's own output stage

reference.packing: ot_a3_tile64's own activation rule: a slice is rows x ceil(depth_b / g) 64-bit words at op_a_base + (b mod 2) x op_a_block_stride, word w holding the g elements of one k-group at element_width bits each
reference.rounding: binary32 -> BF16 round-to-nearest-even, the contract of rtl/ot_fp32_rne_pkg.sv::fp32_to_bf16_rne, restated here

manifest.required_marker_prefix: PASS: ABI3 operand receiver cases=18 words=584 slices=17

readiness_delay.invariant_over: g = 1, 2 and 4, one to three slices, a nonzero op_a_base, and three idle cycles between roots
readiness_delay.rule: the cycles from the root that completes a K-block slice to the cycle act_ready_kblocks names that slice: one to write the activation word into the FIFO and one for the tile to see the readiness, so the tile never reads a word before it has landed.  Measured, not predicted, and required to be the same on both simulators
